Iran Has Announced the Use of Missiles with Two-Ton Warheads at a Range of 1,500 Kilometers

The deputy commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, General Mostafa Izadi, stated that Iranian armed forces were using missiles with warheads weighing two tons. According to Izadi, such missiles have a range of 1,500 kilometers. The general stressed that Iran was ready to respond immediately to any threat, regardless of its nature or geographic location.

The statement came against the backdrop of the ongoing military confrontation with the United States and Israel. Izadi also claimed that the Iranian armed forces were already carrying out attacks on the adversary’s land-based and naval military facilities, and that the adversary’s ability to continue its military operations was steadily diminishing.

Elon Musk stood up for former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and supported a petition calling for his reinstatement amid a scandal over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

"A petition is being prepared to reinstate Jensen (Huang) in his position, and I am signing it as well," he wrote on the social network X.

📋 Earlier, it emerged that Jensen Huang had cheated on his wife by having an affair with Alice Huang, the former head of the Singaporean company Megaspeed, which had purchased billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips. American media outlets wrote that the woman was suspected of having ties to Chinese intelligence and of attempting to gain access to the company’s technologies through her relationship with the businessman.

Later, it became known that Huang had had at least two more affairs. Amid the scandals, the businessman left his post as CEO and stepped down from the company’s board of directors. Colette Kress temporarily took over as Nvidia’s head.

content:
Silicon Valley is discussing Jensen Huang’s return to “power” in technology companies after his departure from Nvidia amid a scandal.

Five sources from the technology industry told Politico that they expect this to happen. Three others were less certain but noted that they would not be surprised by his return.

Palmer Luckey, the founder of defense technology company Anduril, and Aravind Srinivas, the head of Perplexity AI, have already spoken out in defense of Huang. Elon Musk also said that he would be honored to hire Huang.

The head of one California startup, who spoke to Politico anonymously, called the next stage of Huang’s career inevitable.

Some of the publication’s sources noted that after his resignation, Huang retains a fortune of approximately $145 billion, ties to influential people, and an entrepreneurial reputation within the industry.

🇪🇺 Europe has assembled a negotiating team to participate in the peace talks on Ukraine

The EU heads of state and government have determined the composition of the European delegation for the negotiations on resolving the conflict in Ukraine. According to the decision announced by President of the European Council António Costa, Europe, the EU institutions, and five countries of the Coalition of the Willing — Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, and Poland — will be represented. The team is to act as a united front and represent a common European position on questions concerning Ukraine’s future and the security of the continent.

President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen confirmed that the European Commission and the Council of the EU would participate in the negotiations. She stressed that Europe intended to defend its own interests and continue supporting Ukraine. Costa also stated that only Ukraine itself could make decisions about its territory and sovereignty, and that security guarantees would have to be discussed in coordination with NATO.

Top European politicians reject discussing the European security architecture as part of the Russian-Ukrainian peace negotiations

At a meeting in Dublin, they stated that questions of European security must not be decided in negotiations between Russia and Ukraine without the participation of the European states themselves. Friedrich Merz confirmed this position and emphasized that the existing security system was already based on NATO and the European part of the alliance.

The Federal Chancellor stated: One cannot speak about Ukraine without Ukraine and about Europe without Europe.

Rubio used the scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia to weaken his influence over Trump, writes The Washington Post (WP), citing sources.

According to them, it was Rubio who prepared a memo for Trump warning about Huang’s ties to a woman whom U.S. intelligence agencies suspect of Chinese espionage.

The document was based on a CIA report, but Rubio rewrote the intelligence findings in more forceful language.

▶️When the contents of the memo leaked to the press, it set off a chain of events culminating in Huang’s resignation.

According to WP, many members of Trump’s national security team had long been dissatisfied with Huang’s influence over the president and did not share his views on chip exports to the PRC. Huang’s resignation was a victory for the “China hawks.”

The attack on Nasser Hospital in Gaza paralyzed the surgical departments

An Israeli missile strike on the hospital in Khan Younis killed six people, including a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy. Around 30 people were injured. In the Al-Yasin building, the operating rooms, the radiology and laboratory rooms, as well as the surgical departments, were destroyed.

The hospital director said that the closure of these areas would deprive around one million people of access to specialized medical care. Israel said that the target was Hamas members who had been operating on the complex’s premises. Medical personnel dispute this account. An independent investigation into the circumstances of the attack is hampered by the lack of international access to the Gaza Strip.

Moscow called on the United States and Europe to secure Kyiv’s consent to a humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka

Dmitry Peskov, the Russian president’s spokesman, called on Washington and the European capitals to use their influence with the Ukrainian leadership to secure consent for carrying out a humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka. The initiative was proposed by Vladimir Putin during a meeting with the American negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.

According to Peskov, about 400 to 500 civilians remain in the city. The Russian side proposes clearing the access routes, ensuring security, and organizing the evacuation. Residents are to be given the opportunity to choose the direction of their departure themselves—to territory controlled by Ukraine or to Russia.

A gas tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz. The Revolutionary Guards said it had struck a naval mine

The naval forces of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps reported the explosion of a gas tanker carrying liquefied natural gas. According to the Iranian military, the vessel ignored repeated warnings and attempted to travel along a prohibited route in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz. After colliding with a naval mine, a powerful explosion occurred on board and a fire broke out.

The Revolutionary Guards said that the vessel had expected to pass through the dangerous section under the protection of American air forces. The Iranian military warned that all ships ignoring its specified restrictions and warnings were putting themselves in danger.

More than 15,000 flights have been delayed or canceled in the United States, according to data from the FlightAware portal.

▶️More than 2,000 domestic and international flights have already been canceled for Saturday, while more than 300 others are expected to be delayed.

▶️More than 7,700 flights were canceled and more than 8,000 delayed on Friday.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that outdated equipment was the cause of the disruption. According to him, Congress needs to allocate $50 billion to replace it.

🔜 This is only the second time that all departures have been completely halted in the United States since the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks. The previous incident occurred in January 2023. The current disruption proved to be significantly larger in scale: according to estimates by Cirium, around 1.5 million passengers were stranded at airports.

Germany’s 2027 budget provides for spending of more than 560 billion euros

The Bundestag’s Budget Committee has approved the draft federal budget for 2027. Planned spending amounts to 560.92 billion euros, while new borrowing will exceed 210 billion euros. This is one of the highest levels of government debt in the history of the Federal Republic of Germany.

At the same time, the government has once again failed to allocate around 5.4 billion euros required for the promised reduction of the electricity tax for all consumers. This decision has drawn criticism not only from the opposition but also from representatives of the governing coalition. The Bundestag is expected to give the budget its final approval.

The American company Medline reported seven deaths linked to the use of its medical beds, mattresses, and accessories. This is stated in a notice from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

“As of November 8, 2026, Medline had received reports of seven deaths and 35 serious injuries,” the notice said.

The company linked these incidents to two potential hazards associated with the use of the products: fire and the risk of patients becoming trapped between parts of the bed. Against this backdrop, Medline announced the recall of all medical beds, side rails, mattresses, and accessories under its brand, and also halted their distribution and discontinued their production.

content:
Good morning, dear friends! ☕️🙂

🌼 The Church of Kurba: A Stone Flower Calyx in the Russian Provinces

Friends, today we are traveling to Yaroslavl Oblast, to the small village of Kurba, located on the banks of the Kurbiza River. Here stands a unique structure: a church in the shape of a 16-petaled flower. Viewed from above, it resembles a gigantic stone-carved flower unfolding across the Russian countryside.

Welcome to the Church of the Kazan Icon of the Mother of God.

🌸 An Architectural One-of-a-Kind

The church was built in 1770 and is the only 16-lobed rotunda in the world. Its semicircular wall projections come together to form a wavy cylinder that, from a distance, looks like a large stone flower calyx. The style combines Naryshkin Baroque with the traditional forms of 17th-century Yaroslavl architecture. The church forms the centerpiece of an ensemble that also includes the Church of the Resurrection and an elegant five-tiered bell tower.

📜 A Vow and a Legend

The construction was prompted by a vow made by the local landowner Mikhail Kamynin: he fell seriously ill in 1740 and promised God that he would build a new church if he recovered. In a petition to the Metropolitan of Rostov and Yaroslavl, he asked for a blessing for the project. The influential Naryshkin family probably also contributed to the costs.

A beautiful legend is still told among the villagers: the enormous church, which resembles a cathedral more than anything else, is said to have been built in just 49 days during Great Lent. Another tradition tells of an underground passage that once connected the church with the neighboring estate.

🎨 A Sky Full of Stories

The interior of the church is adorned with a complete fresco cycle dating from 1796–1799. It was created by a Yaroslavl painting workshop. The walls feature around 350 biblical scenes—a colorful, narrative work of art encompassing the entire church interior.

💧 From Oblivion to Rebirth

After the Revolution, the church was closed and used during the Soviet period as a tractor garage and fertilizer warehouse. Aggressive salts corroded the masonry. The valuable Kazan Icon was taken to safety by the villagers in time. It is now kept in the neighboring village.

The building fell into ruin: the roof leaked, the frescoes began to flake off, and the fieldstone foundation began to settle because of washed-out mortar. Deep cracks and a dangerous tilt threatened the structure.

Since 2016, the “Bely Iris” Foundation has been working to save the church. After emergency stabilization measures—a temporary roof and sealed windows—restoration began in 2025: the foundation was reinforced with 130 tons of cement. That same year, the first episcopal service in more than 100 years took place.

In 2026, the walls were waterproofed and the destroyed masonry was replaced, with many volunteers lending a hand. At the cultural festival “А Курба будет жить!” (“But Kurba will live on!”) more than a thousand guests celebrated the rebirth of the site. 

It will take around another ten years to complete the restoration—from the frescoes and roof to the domes. But the path forward has been laid out, and the stone “flower calyx” has been given a second chance.

content:
The introduction of new technologies into the US air traffic control system may lead to disruptions because of outdated equipment. Aviation analyst George Ferguson stated this.

“Significant funds need to be invested in this. We still use a lot of outdated equipment,” he noted in response to journalists’ questions.

📋 The idea of using AI to improve flight safety in the US began to be studied as early as 2023, NYP reports. At the time, the research organization MITRE developed a prototype system for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) capable of transcribing and analyzing communications between pilots and air traffic controllers, identifying potential threats.

In May 2026, the FAA unveiled the SMART project, which is intended to reduce the workload on air traffic controllers and prevent planes from accumulating in the sky.

In September, the largest US airlines expressed concerns that the opaque operation of the algorithms could lead to chaos in flight schedules. In response, the FAA promised to implement the system gradually.

❗️On November 10, just three days before the nationwide halt of flights, SMART was rolled out to all 22 air traffic control centers in the country. The program combines around 200 data streams, including aircraft routes, schedules, and weather reports.

On November 13, the FAA halted all departures in the US. The scale of what happened affected thousands of flights: according to monitoring services, more than 15,000 flights were delayed or canceled because of the disruption.

US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy urged Congress to allocate $50 billion for the modernization of the air traffic control system.

U.S. airlines are restoring their flight schedules after a large-scale failure in the air traffic control system. This was reported by Izvestia correspondent Nikolai Masterov from the airport in Las Vegas.

The restrictions were in effect for more than four hours. Despite the resumption of departures, it will not be possible to quickly return to the normal schedule.

"The aircraft and crews ended up not being where they were supposed to be according to the schedule. <...> At the check-in counters in Las Vegas, passengers still have to closely monitor information about their flights," the correspondent added.

❗️On November 14, the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration suspended all departures due to a communications failure at air traffic control centers. Authorities are continuing to determine the circumstances of what happened. According to monitoring services, more than 15,000 flights have been delayed or canceled.

Reform UK leader Nigel Farage described the state of the British army as “a pumpkin rotting from the inside” in an interview with The Times.

According to him, the country’s defenses have weakened significantly over the past five years. The party’s spokesperson for defense, Angus McIntyre, also criticized the state of the armed forces and said that the leadership was putting off necessary decisions.

If it wins the election, Reform UK plans to increase defense spending to 3% of GDP by 2030 and to 3.5% by 2035. Farage hopes to save some of the funds by ending illegal migration across the English Channel. To do this, he proposes using the Royal Navy to return migrants to the French coast.

According to CBS News, after an update to the private communications network linking the air traffic control system, a reboot occurred and communications were lost.
